entity.pets-mod.head: Floating Head
message.pets-mod.pet-skin-change-fail: §b[PetsMod] §cEither your currently selected pet doesn't support multiple skins, or that is not a valid skin. Try something else.
message.pets-mod.pet-help:
§b[PetsMod] §aPossible commands:
§a/pet help: §rdisplays a list of commands
§a/pet toggle <on/off> §rtoggles whether your pet will appear or not
§a/pet species <species>: §rchanges the species of your pet
§a/pet skin <skin>: §rchanges the skin of your selected pet
§a/teleportpet: §rteleports your pet to you. will not work if you are not on the ground.
§a/pet name: §rchanges the name of your currently selected pet
message.pets-mod.unsupported-species: §b[PetsMod] §cThat's not a pet that's currently supported. Try something else. (Unknown input %s§c)
message.pets-mod.pet-switched-to: §b[PetsMod] §aYour active pet has been switched to %s§c.
message.pets-mod.pet-switched-to-not-on: §b[PetsMod] §cYour pet has been switched to %s§c, but you currently do not have your pet enabled. Run §l/pet on§r§c to change this.
message.pets-mod.screen.could-not-load-p: ⚠ Could not load 3D model of your pet because you are not in a level.
message.pets-mod.tips-text:
Hi! Here are some quick tips for Pets Mod. 

Shifting and right clicking a pet will pick it up, whereas jumping and 
right clicking a pet will make it sit and stay. Not all pets have a 
 sitting animation, so make sure to note this. 

 You can change/toggle these keybinds in the 
'keybinds' section of the main menu. 

Use /pet help to view a list of commands. 

Use the 'report issues' button under 'other' to report any 
issues you are having with Pets Mod. 


Finally, don't click this button :)
message.pets-mod.update-available: §b[Pets Mod] §aPets Mod version %s§a is available for download.
message.description.pets-mod.auto-instal: Automatically downloads and installs the new version for you. Changes will apply when you restart.
message.description.pets-mod.view: View the version and changelog on Modrinth.
message.description.pets-mod.dismiss: Dismisses the message for THIS update. To turn off these messages, open the config screen, go to 'other' and turn 'Receive Update Notifications' off.
message.pets-mod.dismissed: §b[Pets Mod] §aThe notification for this update has been dismissed, however you will still receive mentions for the next one. To turn this off, open the config screen, go to 'other' and turn 'Receive Update Notifications' off.
message.pets-mod.screen.pet-on-tooltip: Toggle whether your pet appears on or not.
message.pets-mod.screen.is-baby-tooltip: Toggle whether your pet appears as a baby.
message.pets-mod.screen.render-pet-hitbo: Toggle whether to show specifically your pet's hitboxes. (You will still have to turn hitboxes on if this is enabled)
message.pets-mod.screen.wandering-enable: Toggle whether your pet will get bored and wander when you stand still for too long.
message.pets-mod.screen.always-show-name: Toggle whether your pet's nametag will always appear, regardless of whether your crosshair is over it.
message.pets-mod.screen.hit-through-pets: Allows you to 'ghost hand' pets, meaning hitting or breaking blocks through them. Useful for PvP.
message.pets-mod.screen.notify-updates: Whether you will receive notifications about the most recent Pets Mod updates, and have the option to automatically install them.
